description: This script is a benchmark runner for various kernel implementations, providing a command-line interface to run, list, and visualize benchmarks for kernels like CrossEntropy, Softmax, RMSNorm, and LayerNorm in both forward and backward modes.

methods.name: show_environment_info
methods.description: Displays environment information including Python, PyTorch, and CUDA versions.

methods.name: list_benchmarks
methods.description: Lists all available benchmark names from the registry.

methods.name: _run_benchmark
methods.description: Executes a benchmark given its class and script arguments, reports results, and visualizes if requested.

methods.name: run_benchmark
methods.description: Runs a specific benchmark by name if it exists in the registry.

methods.name: run_all_benchmarks
methods.description: Runs all benchmarks registered in the registry.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, displays environment info, and manages benchmark execution flow.
